scope: Official federal changes potentially relevant to GrantOS. Source facts are distinct from conditional impact assessments. An entry does not assert that GrantOS has an active external connector or that implementation is complete.

updates.title: SAM.gov site certificate validity and renewal
updates.confirmed_change: SAM.gov says website certificates will have 100-day validity beginning March 15, 2027, and new SAM certificates will renew automatically. External partners are instructed to prepare for the renewal process.
updates.affected_grantos_component: Any current or future SAM.gov HTTPS/API client, trust configuration, and integration operations.
updates.likely_impact: A client that pins a leaf certificate or ships a fixed certificate bundle may fail after rotation. This is conditional; no such GrantOS configuration has been verified.
updates.next_step: Inventory SAM.gov endpoint clients, certificate pinning, trust stores, proxies, and certificate-expiry alerts. If fixed leaf material exists, replace it with a supported trust and rotation approach before March 15, 2027.

updates.title: SAM.gov Contract Awards data delay
updates.confirmed_change: SAM.gov warned that Contract Awards Management and Data Bank reports covering date ranges on or after October 18, 2026, could be incomplete or outdated. The warning is now marked inactive.
updates.affected_grantos_component: Any current or future Contract Awards import, reconciliation, and analytics.
updates.likely_impact: If GrantOS imported affected reports, cached data may require replay and reconciliation. Active ingestion has not been established.
updates.next_step: Determine whether Contract Awards reports were ingested for October 18 onward. If yes, replay the affected range and compare record counts and update timestamps against current SAM.gov data.

updates.title: SAM.gov Entity Management daily extract schedule
updates.confirmed_change: Entity Management daily extracts are posted every day of the week, replacing the former Tuesday-through-Saturday schedule.
updates.affected_grantos_component: Any current or future SAM entity/UEI synchronization and registration eligibility checks.
updates.likely_impact: A Tuesday-through-Saturday ingestion job would leave Sunday and Monday extracts pending. No GrantOS extract job has been verified.
updates.next_step: Inspect the actual extract scheduler. If it uses the old cadence, run it daily with idempotent processing and a last-successful checkpoint; validate the Sunday and Monday file format and naming.

updates.title: SAM.gov Contract Awards API optional filter and response fields
updates.confirmed_change: The v1 Contract Awards API documentation added the optional publicDeltaDate filter, which selects by last-modified or reveal date, and the optional coreData.productOrServiceInformation.commercialProductService response object with code and name.
updates.affected_grantos_component: Any current or future SAM Contract Awards parser and incremental sync.
updates.likely_impact: Strict response validation could reject the extra object; a lastModifiedDate-only cursor could miss newly revealed records. These are inferred risks and no Contract Awards connector has been verified.
updates.next_step: Check whether GrantOS has Contract Awards ingestion. If active, test against Alpha with unknown-field tolerance and compare publicDeltaDate versus lastModifiedDate replay behavior; map the added fields as optional.
